notes.title: Toymaker - Christmas patch 2017!
notes.content:
A new patch, straight from the claws of the Toymaker, is out this Christmas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196807/fd9b83c921a76b14d846d0d9cecca32c52370e30.png[/img]

The biggest change is that the d-pad functions correctly for gamepads now. No more using the stick for walking around. Or, you could still do that if you'd like, of course.


[b]Fixes:[/b]

- D-pads now work for gamepads.
- Fixed the crack- and break-skills. They now apply status-effects correctly.
- Small balance changes.
- Some minor text fixes.


Stay safe in the deep midwinter night!

notes.title: Update: Heart of Mara
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196807/3e002413e2806d605ae8aa1f50faf303c5b6d773.png[/img]

Toymaker will receive a large, and free, update the 1st of may. With the following features:

[h1]Heart of Mara[/h1]
[list]
    [*]A new side-quest, spanning over both the Prologue and the main game.
    [*]With new, strange enemies, and a minor boss and a large one too.
    [*]A new area, that delves deeper into the minds of some of your followers and exposing more of the rotting core of the world of Toymaker.
[/list]

[h1]The Prologue[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The Prologue will be playable through the main game, together with the Heart of Mara update and its new story and enemies.
    [*]A stand-alone story, following Baldor as he tries to save his village from the dark things skulking in the midwinter night.
    [*]The Prologue gives more backstory to the cold world of Toymaker, and shows the beginning of the saga.
[/list]

[h1]Patch[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Some small balance changes.
    [*]Minor spell checking.
    [*]A few bug-fixes.
[/list]
